pb-books-finance.heading: Books and receipts
pb-books-finance.boundary: Prepare client books and review every entry. The client accounting system remains the record.
pb-books-finance.stale: Source changed. Prepare this entry again.
pb-books-finance.approved: Approved for the bookkeeper. Nothing posted.
pb-books-finance.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This finance action could not finish. Check the order and source file.
pb-books-finance.error.BOOKS_CYCLE_INVAL: Choose the correct client cycle and a date inside it.
pb-books-finance.error.BOOKS_CYCLE_EXIST: This finance cycle already exists. Select it above.
pb-books-finance.error.BOOKS_SETUP_INVAL: Check the account entries and exact rupee amounts.
pb-books-finance.error.BOOKS_RECEIPT_REQ: Choose a receipt uploaded to this client order.
pb-books-finance.error.BOOKS_RECEIPT_CHA: The receipt changed. Draft the entry again.
pb-books-finance.error.APPROVAL_STALE: This entry changed. Read it again before approving.
pb-books-finance.taxReview: A CA must confirm tax sections. Nothing was posted or filed.
pb-books-finance.templateHelp: Download a blank CSV, fill it with client records, then upload it to the client order. Keep the column names. All rupee columns accept decimal text.
pb-books-finance.setupHelp: Setup kinds: {kinds}. Opening rows use an account ID and both rupee columns; leave name blank. Other rows leave rupee columns blank.
pb-books-finance.monthlyHelp: Monthly kinds: {kinds}. Include every order and its settlement evidence. Tax credits have their own source and section.
pb-books-finance.setupManual: This is a review package for the bookkeeper. Enter or map the approved records in the client system, then compare its opening balances with the receipt. This export creates no client records.
